color_rules: White text on teal is 2.41:1 and fails WCAG AA. Every teal fill carries navy text.
Teal-text (#0B7A65) is the only teal used for text on paper or white.
Coral is for urgency and the voter path only, never for a cook's primary action.
Gold marks a reward or a prize, never a control.
font_rules: Instrument Serif is the display face for English headings only. It has no Arabic.
Cairo is the display and body face for Arabic. Arabic headings use Cairo, never a serif.
Permanent Marker appears only on B1, the poster screen. Never in product chrome.
Minimum type size: 11px for Arabic, 10px for Latin. Enforced at build time on the canvas.
layout_rules: One primary action per screen, and it must be reachable without scrolling.
Long screens put the primary action in a sticky bar at the bottom and scroll the body behind it.
Sticky action bars: A3, B3, B3d, C1, C3, E5, H2, H4.
A scroll hint appears at the bottom of the scroll area when content continues below the fold.
